$comment: Regulatory source-of-truth ledger. Every statutory/guideline constant in the codebase has an entry: where it comes from, where it lives in code, when a human last verified it against the official source, and how often it must be re-verified. scripts/regulatory-freshness.cjs (run by npm run checkup and the daily guardian) FAILS when any entry is overdue. When you verify a value against its source, update lastVerified (YYYY-MM-DD). Never change a value without a citation — that is a Correction to the scenario registry.

entries.rule: Deferred/$0-payment student loans qualified at 1% of outstanding balance
entries.citation: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-05 (Monthly Debt Obligations)
entries.notes: NC-01 open in the scenarios registry: generated sources claim 0.5% (that is the FHA Handbook 4000.1 figure). Documented IDR payments may be usable per guide — confirm on next verification.

entries.rule: Self-employment/contract income seasoning: 24 months full; 12-24 conditional
entries.citation: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-3.2 (Self-Employment Income)

entries.rule: Single deposits > 50% of monthly qualifying income must be sourced
entries.citation: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-4.2-02 (Depository Accounts); gifts resolved per B3-4.3-04

entries.rule: VA residual income baselines by region/family size; $0.14/sqft utilities; 120% cushion when DTI > 41%
entries.notes: Residual tables are loan-amount-banded; implemented band is >= $80,000. Verify table values on each review.

entries.rule: Standard DTI ceiling used for flags/what-if coaching
entries.citation: PLATFORM POLICY referencing legacy QM 43% (12 CFR §1026.43 Appendix Q, repealed 2021 — replaced by price-based General QM)
entries.notes: REVIEW CANDIDATE: DU approves DTIs up to 50% with compensating factors; the 43% figure is a conservative platform flag threshold, not a current federal cap. Decide whether to align flag threshold with DU 50% or keep conservative.

entries.citation: Homeowners Protection Act, 12 U.S.C. §4901 et seq. (borrower-requested cancellation at 80% LTV of original value; automatic termination at 78%)
entries.notes: Alert uses current estimated value (AVM); statutory cancellation right keys off original value — the alert is an opportunity signal, the letter/request path must use HPA terms.

entries.rule: Low-reserves warning threshold (months of PITI post-closing)
entries.citation: PLATFORM POLICY; Fannie reserve requirements (B3-4.1-01) vary by transaction — formal mapping pending
entries.notes: Foundation scenario note in the registry: research proper per-transaction reserve requirements.

entries.rule: Document freshness window used for aging alerts
entries.citation: PLATFORM POLICY (stricter than Fannie B1-1-03, which allows credit documents up to 4 months old for most transactions)
entries.notes: Deliberately conservative; being stricter than the guideline is compliant. Review whether 30-day nagging is too aggressive once real borrowers exist.

entries.rule: Anti-steering loan-options disclosure before rate lock
entries.notes: Template text is a summary; legal review recommended before real borrowers sign it (roadmap #26).

entries.citation: Fannie Mae DU Version 12.1 release notes
entries.notes: Simulated until FANNIE_DU_API_KEY; verify current DU version before go-live.
